[[File:Sand_hopper.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A sand hopper on patrol]]
A '''sand hopper''' was a creature similar to a [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]] ridden by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] patrollers on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarina]].

==Behind the scenes==
This craft was introduced in a feature called ''Build this super stand-up model'', which could be cut out of the comic book and folded into a paper model.
